chunks: They are the ones whose hearts and ears and eyes have been sealed by God; and these are the heedless.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God seals the hearts and ears of people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this sealing (ṭabʿ) is often understood as a divine confirmation of the state of those who persistently reject truth after it has become clear to them, rather than a total deprivation of capacity. The triad of heart, hearing, and sight signifies the complete closure of the internal and external channels of perception, rendering them among the 'ghāfilūn' (heedless) who are oblivious to their own spiritual stagnation.
